verses.en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
verses.pt: De novo veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,

verses.en: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
verses.pt: Tu pois, ó filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Tiro;
verses.en_web: “You, son of man, take up a lamentation over Tyre;
verses.en_bbe: And you, son of man, make a song of grief for Tyre;

verses.en: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
verses.pt: e dize a Tiro, que habita na entrada do mar, e negocia com os povos em muitas ilhas: Assim diz o Senhor Deus: ç Tiro, tu dizes: Eu sou perfeita em formosura.
verses.en_web: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’
verses.en_bbe: And say to Tyre, O you who are seated at the doorway of the sea, trading for the peoples with the great sea-lands, these are the words of the Lord: You, O Tyre, have said, I am a ship completely beautiful.

verses.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
verses.pt: No coração dos mares estão os teus termos; os que te edificaram aperfeiçoaram a tua formosura.
verses.en_web: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
verses.en_bbe: Your builders have made your outlines in the heart of the seas, they have made you completely beautiful.

verses.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
verses.pt: De ciprestes de Senir fizeram todas as tuas tábuas; trouxeram cedros do Líbano para fazerem um mastro para ti.
verses.en_web: They have made all your planks of cypress trees from Senir. They have taken a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast for you.
verses.en_bbe: They have made all your boards of fir-trees from Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make the supports for your sails.

verses.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
verses.pt: Fizeram os teus remos de carvalhos de Basã; os teus bancos fizeram-nos de marfim engastado em buxo das ilhas de Quitim.
verses.en_web: They have made your oars of the oaks of Bashan. They have made your benches of ivory inlaid in boxwood from the islands of Kittim.
verses.en_bbe: Of oak-trees from Bashan they have made your driving blades; they have made your floors of ivory and boxwood from the sea-lands of Kittim.

verses.en: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
verses.pt: Linho fino bordado do Egito era a tua vela, para te servir de estandarte; de azul, e púrpura das ilhas de Elisá era a tua cobertura.
verses.en_web: Your sail was of fine linen with embroidered work from Egypt, that it might be to you for a banner. Blue and purple from the islands of Elishah was your awning.
verses.en_bbe: The best linen with needlework from Egypt was your sail, stretched out to be a flag for you; blue and purple from the sea-lands of Elishah gave you shade.

verses.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
verses.pt: Os habitantes de Sidom e de Arvade eram os teus remadores; os teus peritos, ó Tiro, que em ti se achavam, esses eram os teus pilotos.
verses.en_web: The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were your rowers. Your wise men, Tyre, were in you. They were your pilots.
verses.en_bbe: The people of Zidon and Arvad were your boatmen; the wise men of Zemer were in you; they were guiding your ships;

verses.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
verses.pt: Os anciãos de Gebal e seus peritos eram em ti os teus calafates; todos os navios do mar e os seus marinheiros se achavam em ti, para tratarem dos teus negócios.
verses.en_web: The old men of Gebal and its wise men were your repairers of ship seams in you. All the ships of the sea with their mariners were in you to deal in your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: The responsible men of Gebal and its wise men were in you, making your boards watertight: all the ships of the sea with their seamen were in you trading in your goods.

verses.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
verses.pt: Os persas, e os lídios, e os de Pute eram no teu exército os teus soldados; penduravam em ti o escudo e o capacete; aumentavam o teu esplendor.
verses.en_web: “‘“Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army, your men of war. They hung the shield and helmet in you. They showed your beauty.
verses.en_bbe: Cush and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war, hanging up their body-covers and head-dresses of war in you: they gave you your glory.

verses.en: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Arvade e o teu exército estavam sobre os teus muros em redor, e os gamaditas nas tuas torres; penduravam os seus escudos nos teus muros em redor; aperfeiçoavam a tua formosura.
verses.en_web: The men of Arvad with your army were on your walls all around, and valient men were in your towers. They hung their shields on your walls all around. They have perfected your beauty.
verses.en_bbe: The men of Arvad in your army were on your walls, and were watchmen in your towers, hanging up their arms on your walls round about; they made you completely beautiful.

verses.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
verses.pt: Társis negociava contigo, por causa da abundância de toda a casta de riquezas; seus negociantes trocavam pelas tuas mercadorias prata, ferro, estanho, e chumbo.
verses.en_web: “‘“Tarshish was your merchant by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches. They traded for your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
verses.en_bbe: Tarshish did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth; they gave silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.

verses.en: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
verses.pt: Javã, Tubál e Meseque eram teus mercadores; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam as pessoas de homens e vasos de bronze.
verses.en_web: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of brass for your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders; they gave living men and brass vessels for your goods.

verses.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
verses.pt: Os da casa de Togarma trocavam pelas tuas mercadorias cavalos e ginetes e machos;
verses.en_web: “‘“They of the house of Togarmah traded for your wares with horses, war horses, and mules.
verses.en_bbe: The people of Togarmah gave horses and war-horses and transport beasts for your goods.

verses.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
verses.pt: os homens de Dedã eram teus mercadores; muitas ilhas eram o mercado da tua mão; tornavam a trazer-te em troca de dentes de marfim e pau de ébano.
verses.en_web: “‘“The men of Dedan traded with you. Many islands were the market of your hand. They brought you horns of ivory and ebony in exchange.
verses.en_bbe: The men of Rodan were your traders: a great number of sea-lands did business with you: they gave you horns of ivory and ebony as an offering.

verses.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
verses.pt: A Síria negociava contigo por causa da multidão das tuas manufaturas; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam granadas, púrpura, obras bordadas, linho fino, corais e rubis.
verses.en_web: “‘“Syria was your merchant by reason of the multitude of your handiworks. They traded for your wares with emeralds, purple, embroidered work, fine linen, coral, and rubies.
verses.en_bbe: Edom did business with you because of the great number of things which you made; they gave emeralds, purple, and needlework, and the best linen and coral and rubies for your goods.

verses.en: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
verses.pt: Judá e a terra de Israel eram teus mercadores; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam o trigo de Minite, cera, mel, azeite e bálsamo.
verses.en_web: “‘“Judah and the land of Israel were your traders. They traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil, and balm for your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: Judah and the land of Israel were your traders; they gave grain of Minnith and sweet cakes and honey and oil and perfume for your goods.

verses.en: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.pt: Por causa da multidão das tuas manufaturas, por causa da multidão de toda a sorte de riquezas, Damasco negociava contigo em vinho de Helbom e lã branca.
verses.en_web: “‘“Damascus was your merchant for the multitude of your handiworks, by reason of the multitude of all kinds of riches, with the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
verses.en_bbe: Damascus did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.

verses.en: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
verses.pt: Vedã e Javã de Uzal trocavam lã fiada pelas tuas manufaturas; ferro polido, cássia e cálamo aromático achavam-se entre as tuas mercadorias.
verses.en_web: “‘“Vedan and Javan traded with yarn for your wares: bright iron, cassia, and calamus were among your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: ... for your goods: they gave polished iron and spices for your goods.

verses.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
verses.pt: Dedã negociava contigo em suadouros para cavalgar.
verses.en_web: “‘“Dedan was your trafficker in precious cloths for riding.
verses.en_bbe: Dedan did trade with you in cloths for the backs of horses.

verses.en: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
verses.pt: Arábia e todos os príncipes de Quedar também eram os mercadores ao teu serviço; em cordeiros, carneiros e bodes, nestas coisas negociavam contigo.
verses.en_web: “‘“Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar were the merchants of your hand; in lambs, rams, and goats. In these, they were your merchants.
verses.en_bbe: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar did business with you; in lambs and sheep and goats, in these they did business with you.

verses.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.pt: Os mercadores de Sabá e Raamá igualmente negociavam contigo; pelas tuas mercadorias trocavam as melhores de todas as especiarias e toda a pedra preciosa e ouro.
verses.en_web: “‘“The traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders. They traded for your wares with the chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
verses.en_bbe: The traders of Sheba and Raamah did trade with you; they gave the best of all sorts of spices and all sorts of stones of great price and gold for your goods.

verses.en: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
verses.pt: Harã, e Cané e Edem os mercadores de Sabá, Assur e Quilmade eram teus mercadores.
verses.en_web: “‘“Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the traders of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad, were your traders.
verses.en_bbe: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Asshur and all the Medes:

verses.en: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
verses.pt: Estes negociavam contigo em roupas escolhidas, em agasalho de azul e de obra bordada, e em cofres de roupas preciosas, amarrados com cordas e feitos de cedro.
verses.en_web: These were your traders in choice wares, in wrappings of blue and embroidered work, and in chests of rich clothing, bound with cords and made of cedar, among your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: These were your traders in beautiful robes, in rolls of blue and needlework, and in chests of coloured cloth, corded with cords and made of cedar-wood, in them they did trade with you.

verses.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
verses.pt: Os navios de Társis eram as tuas caravanas para a tua mercadoria; e te encheste, e te glorificaste muito no meio dos mares.
verses.en_web: “‘“The ships of Tarshish were your caravans for your merchandise. You were replenished and made very glorious in the heart of the seas.
verses.en_bbe: Tarshish ships did business for you in your goods: and you were made full, and great was your glory in the heart of the seas.

verses.en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
verses.pt: Os teus remadores te conduziram sobre grandes águas; o vento oriental te quebrantou no meio dos mares.
verses.en_web: Your rowers have brought you into great waters. The east wind has broken you in the heart of the seas.
verses.en_bbe: Your boatmen have taken you into great waters: you have been broken by the east wind in the heart of the seas.

verses.en: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
verses.pt: As tuas riquezas, os teus bens, as tuas mercadorias, os teus marinheiros e os teus pilotos, os teus calafates, e os que faziam os teus negócios, e todos os teus soldados, que estão em ti, juntamente com toda a tua companhia, que está no meio de ti, se submergirão no meio dos mares no dia da tua queda.
verses.en_web: Your riches, your wares, your merchandise, your mariners, your pilots, your repairers of ship seams, the dealers in your merchandise, and all your men of war, who are in you, with all your company which is among you, will fall into the heart of the seas in the day of your ruin.
verses.en_bbe: Your wealth and your goods, the things in which you do trade, your seamen and those guiding your ships, those who make your boards watertight, and those who do business with your goods, and all your men of war who are in you, with all who have come together in you, will go down into the heart of the seas in the day of your downfall.

verses.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
verses.pt: Ao estrondo da gritaria dos teus pilotos tremerão os arrabaldes.
verses.en_web: At the sound of the cry of your pilots, the suburbs will shake.
verses.en_bbe: At the sound of the cry of your ships' guides, the boards of the ship will be shaking.

verses.en: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
verses.pt: E todos os que pegam no remo, os marinheiros, e todos os pilotos do mar descerão de seus navios, e pararão em terra,
verses.en_web: All who handle the oars, the mariners and all the pilots of the sea, will come down from their ships. They will stand on the land,
verses.en_bbe: And all the boatmen, the seamen and those who are expert at guiding a ship through the sea, will come down from their ships and take their places on the land;

verses.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
verses.pt: e farão ouvir a sua voz sobre ti, e gritarão amargamente; lançarão pó sobre as cabeças, e na cinza se revolverão;
verses.en_web: and will cause their voice to be heard over you, and will cry bitterly. They will cast up dust on their heads. They will wallow in the ashes.
verses.en_bbe: And their voices will be sounding over you, and crying bitterly they will put dust on their heads, rolling themselves in the dust:

verses.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
verses.pt: e se farão calvos por tua causa, e se cingirão de sacos, e chorarão sobre ti com amargura de alma, com amarga lamentação.
verses.en_web: They will make themselves bald for you, and clothe themselves with sackcloth. They will weep for you in bitterness of soul, with bitter mourning.
verses.en_bbe: And they will have the hair of their heads cut off because of you, and will put haircloth on their bodies, weeping for you with bitter grief in their souls, even with bitter sorrow.

verses.en: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
verses.pt: No seu pranto farão uma lamentação sobre ti, na qual dirão: Quem foi como Tiro, como a que está reduzida ao silêncio no meio do mar?
verses.en_web: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’
verses.en_bbe: And in their weeping they will make a song of grief for you, sorrowing over you and saying, Who is like Tyre, who has come to an end in the deep sea?

verses.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
verses.pt: Quando as tuas mercadorias eram exportadas pelos mares, fartaste a muitos povos; com a multidão das tuas riquezas e das tuas mercadorias, enriqueceste os reis da terra.
verses.en_web: When your wares went out of the seas, you filled many peoples. You enriched the kings of the earth with the multitude of your riches and of your merchandise.
verses.en_bbe: When your goods went out over the seas, you made numbers of peoples full; the wealth of the kings of the earth was increased with your great wealth and all your goods.

verses.en: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
verses.pt: No tempo em que foste quebrantada pelos mares, nas profundezas das águas, caíram no meio de ti todas as tuas mercadorias e toda a tua companhia.
verses.en_web: In the time that you were broken by the seas, in the depths of the waters, your merchandise and all your company fell within you.
verses.en_bbe: Now that you are broken by the seas in the deep waters, your goods and all your people will go down with you.

verses.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
verses.pt: Todos os moradores das ilhas estão a teu respeito cheios de espanto; e os seus reis temem em grande maneira, e estão de semblante perturbado.
verses.en_web: All the inhabitants of the islands are astonished at you, and their kings are horribly afraid. They are troubled in their face.
verses.en_bbe: All the people of the sea-lands are overcome with wonder at you, and their kings are full of fear, their faces are troubled.

verses.en: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
verses.pt: Os mercadores dentre os povos te dão vaias; tu te tornaste em grande espanto, e nao mais existiras.
verses.en_web: The merchants among the peoples hiss at you. You have become a terror, and you will be no more.”’”
verses.en_bbe: Those who do business among the peoples make sounds of surprise at you; you have become a thing of fear, you have come to an end for ever.
